metadata.comments: MODERN AzureActivity connector (Defender-era). Deploys a subscription-scope diagnostic setting that streams the Azure Activity Log to the Log Analytics workspace, replacing the legacy Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/dataSources (AzureActivityLog) approach. This is a SUBSCRIPTION-SCOPE deployment. Invoke it from the parent with a subscription-scoped nested deployment (no resourceGroup). Validate in a sandbox before swapping it into the main flow.

metadata.description: The kind of data connectors to enable. This template acts when it contains 'AzureActivity'.
Full resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace that receives the Activity Log, e.g. /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/<ws>.
